# B2: pre-registered Indian-class routing rule (generated by scripts/fsn_v2_summaries.py)

Rule: if YOLO top-1 is an Indian class (not suppressed) and conf >= c, keep YOLO even below the main threshold; otherwise fall back as usual (hybrid_resolved). Main threshold 0.5.
